prerequisites: Second study section reached (at least 42 ECTS credits from the first study section must be proven).
Prior experience in planning and executing simple projects

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to take over management for small and medium-sized projects in an industrial/technical environment.
Students are able to name and independently carry out the relevant steps in the preliminary phase of project planning.
Students are able to present and discuss results in a short presentation.
Students are able to organize a correct start (kick-off) of a project and complete all necessary preparatory work and analyses for it.
Students are able to plan a project in detail and have also carried this out in a real case.
Students are able to name several methods for analyzing an ongoing project and for creating trend statements about the progress of the project.
Students are able to understand relevant connections in the course of projects and, based on sound methods, make decisions for the further steering of a project.
Students are able to apply new approaches and methods of agile project management.
Students are able to apply basic techniques of scientific work.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals: Definition of project, project triangle (time, budget, performance); Typical project organizations
Preliminary phase of a project: Procedure models; Goal definition; Stakeholder analysis / management; Risk analysis / management; Scope and kick-off; Group work for in-depth study
Planning a project: Project breakdown structure, schedule / network diagrams; Effort estimations; Resource planning
Execution of a project: Progress and trend analyses; Costs / reporting; Controlling and change management
Agile methods of project management: Idea and approach of agile methods in project management; Procedure and roles in Scrum
Additional module on scientific work: Research and sources: Research strategy, evaluation of information sources; Correct citation for scientific papers, plagiarism
